improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly communicating the Claude-powered AI value and the free trial offer. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook—critical for B2B audiences. Including the 3 free searches creates urgency and lowers friction to visit.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace for your business. Try three free searches — no card required."
improvements.rationale: This copy clearly identifies what Gideon is (AI assistant for trade and business), highlights three core value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace), and removes friction by emphasizing the free trial with no payment commitment. The name 'Gideon' adds personality and memorability while 'Meet' creates an approachable introduction.

improvements.suggestion:
**Q: What happens after my three free searches?**

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches with Gideon, you'll be invited to choose a membership plan that fits your needs. Plans start at just US$2 per day, billed monthly—or save 30% with annual billing. As a member, you unlock unlimited access to Gideon's workspace, voice chat, and professional trade and business support.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the conversion moment when free users hit the paywall. It transparently explains what happens next, reinforces value (unlimited access, voice chat, workspace), and highlights the annual savings—reducing friction and building trust at a critical decision point.
